    ? forall a, b, A, B R, epsilon R+:
        abs(a - A) <= epsilon
        abs(b - B) <= epsilon
        =>:
            abs(finite_set_max(union({a}, { b})) - finite_set_max(union({A}, { B}))) <= epsilon
    a - A <= abs(a - A)
    a - A <= abs(a - A) <= epsilon
    a - A <= epsilon
    (a - A) + A <= epsilon + A
    (a - A) + A = a
    epsilon + A = A + epsilon
    a <= A + epsilon
    b - B <= abs(b - B)
    b - B <= abs(b - B) <= epsilon
    b - B <= epsilon
    (b - B) + B <= epsilon + B
    (b - B) + B = b
    epsilon + B = B + epsilon
    b <= B +

    (a - A) + A = a
    epsilon + A = A + epsilon
    a <= A + epsilon
    b - B <= abs(b - B)
    b - B <= abs(b - B) <= epsilon
    b - B <= epsilon
    (b - B) + B <= epsilon + B
    (b - B) + B = b
    epsilon + B = B + epsilon
    b <= B + epsilon
    A <= max(A,B)
    B <= max(A,B)
    A + epsilon <= max(A,B) + epsilon
    B + epsilon <= max(A,B) + epsilon
    a <= A + epsilon <= max(A,B) + epsilon
    a <= max(A,B) + epsilon
    b <= B + epsilon <= max(A,B) + epsilon
    b <= max(A,B) + epsilon
    max(a,b) <= max(A,B) + epsilon
    max(a,b) - max(A,B) <= (max(A,B) + epsilon) - max(A,B)
    (max(A,B) + epsilon) - max(A,B) = epsilon
    max(a,b) - max(A,B) <= epsilon

    B - b <= abs(b - B) <= epsilon

    (B - b) + b = B

    B <= b + epsilon

    b <= max(a,b)

    b + epsilon <= max(a,b) + epsilon

thm r34_chapter06_two_point_max_stability:
    ? forall epsilon R+, u, v, x, y R:
        abs(u - x) < epsilon
        abs(v - y) < epsilon
        $is_finite_set(union({u}, {v}))
        $is_nonempty_set(union({u}, {v}))
        union({u}, {v}) $subset R
        $is_finite_set(union({x}, {y}))
        $is_nonempty_set(union({x}, {y}))
        union({x}, {y}) $subset R
        =>:
            abs(finite_set_max(union({u}, { v})) - finite_set_max(union({x}, { y}))) <= epsilon

# Tracer: MaxLipschitzFromCoordinateBounds.
# Before (direct target rejected; the textbook used a 152-line case proof):
# forall a,b,x,y R, epsilon R+:
#     abs(a-x) <= epsilon
#     abs(b-y) <= epsilon
#     =>:
#         abs(max(a,b)-max(x,y)) <= epsilon
# Former behavior: search_proof miss on the direct maximum bound.
# Now: both checked coordinate error bounds close the target directly.
# Boundary: one error bound, a min/max mismatch, or invalid real domains
# cannot establish this conclusion. Finite-set WD remains mandatory.
# Evidence: target/release/litex -lang en -strict -f examples/proof_nodes/atomic/by_builtin_rule/max_lipschitz_from_coordinate_bounds.lit

forall a,b,x,y R, epsilon R+:
    abs(a-x) <= epsilon
    abs(b-y) <= epsilon
    =>:
        abs(max(a,b)-max(x,y)) <= epsilon

# Analysis Chapter 6's exact mathematical interface, retaining its strict
# error bounds and the existing finite-extremum domains.
thm two_point_max_stability:
    ? forall epsilon R+, u,v,x,y R:
        abs(u-x) < epsilon
        abs(v-y) < epsilon
        $is_finite_set(union({u},{v}))
        $is_nonempty_set(union({u},{v}))
        union({u},{v}) $subset R
        $is_finite_set(union({x},{y}))
        $is_nonempty_set(union({x},{y}))
        union({x},{y}) $subset R
        =>:
            abs(finite_set_max(union({u},{v}))-finite_set_max(union({x},{y}))) <= epsilon

# A displayed pair keeps the original pairwise-distinctness WD guard.
forall a,b,x,y R, epsilon R+:
    a!=b
    x!=y
    abs(a-x)<=epsilon
    abs(b-y)<=epsilon
    $is_finite_set({a,b})
    $is_nonempty_set({a,b})
    {a,b} $subset R
    $is_finite_set({x,y})
    $is_nonempty_set({x,y})
    {x,y} $subset R
    =>:
        abs(finite_set_max({a,b})-finite_set_max({x,y}))<=epsilon

# Boundary: both bounds and the real/finite-extremum domains are required.
# Evidence: target/release/litex -lang en -strict -f examples/proof_nodes/atomic/by_builtin_rule/min_lipschitz_from_coordinate_bounds.lit

        $is_finite_set(union({u},{v}))
        $is_nonempty_set(union({u},{v}))
        union({u},{v}) $subset R
        $is_finite_set(union({x},{y}))
        $is_nonempty_set(union({x},{y}))
        union({x},{y}) $subset R
        =>:
            abs(finite_set_min(union({u},{v}))-finite_set_min(union({x},{y}))) <= epsilon

# A displayed pair keeps the original pairwise-distinctness WD guard.
forall a,b,x,y R, epsilon R+:
    a!=b
    x!=y
    abs(a-x)<=epsilon
    abs(b-y)<=epsilon
    $is_finite_set({a,b})
    $is_nonempty_set({a,b})
    {a,b} $subset R
    $is_finite_set({x,y})
    $is_nonempty_set({x,y})
    {x,y} $subset R
    =>:
        abs(finite_set_min({a,b})-finite_set_min({x,y}))<=epsilon

# Rule: MaxWeakMonotone
# Before (rejected):
# forall a,b,c,d R:
#     a<=c
#     b<=d
#     =>:
#         max(a,b)<=max(c,d)
# Former behavior: strict run success=false, phase search_proof.
# Now (verified directly):
forall a,b,c,d R:
    a<=c
    b<=d
    =>:
        max(a,b)<=max(c,d)

forall a,b,c R:
    a<=b
    =>:
        max(c,a)<=max(c,b)

# Boundary: Both argument orders must be checked, or that argument must be identical; one missing unequal argument order rejects.
# Gate: target/release/litex -strict -f examples/proof_nodes/atomic/by_builtin_rule/binary_max_weak_monotone.lit
# Regression: tests/unit/execute/legacy_six_simple_bt/tests.rs

#     =>:

    b<=d
    =>:

forall a,b,c R:
    a<=b
    =>:
        min(a,c)<=min(b,c)

# Tracer: MaxLipschitzFromCoordinateBounds.
# Before (direct target rejected; the textbook used a 152-line case proof):
# forall a,b,x,y R, epsilon R+:
#     abs(a-x) <= epsilon
#     abs(b-y) <= epsilon
#     =>:
#         abs(max(a,b)-max(x,y)) <= epsilon
# Former behavior: search_proof miss on the direct maximum bound.
# Now: both checked coordinate error bounds close the target directly.
# Boundary: one error bound, a min/max mismatch, or invalid real domains
# cannot establish this conclusion. Finite-set WD remains mandatory.
# Evidence: target/release/litex -lang en -strict -f examples/proof_nodes/atomic/by_builtin_rule/max_lipschitz_from_coordinate_bounds.lit

forall a,b,x,y R, epsilon R+:
    abs(a-x) <= epsilon
    abs(b-y) <= epsilon
    =>:
        abs(max(a,b)-max(x,y)) <= epsilon

# Analysis Chapter 6's exact mathematical interface, retaining its strict
# error bounds and the existing finite-extremum domains.
thm two_point_max_stability:
    ? forall epsilon R+, u,v,x,y R:
        abs(u-x) < epsilon
        abs(v-y) < epsilon
        $is_finite_set(union({u},{v}))
        $is_nonempty_set(union({u},{v}))
        union({u},{v}) $subset R
        $is_finite_set(union({x},{y}))
        $is_nonempty_set(union({x},{y}))
        union({x},{y}) $subset R
        =>:
            abs(finite_set_max(union({u},{v}))-finite_set_max(union({x},{y}))) <= epsilon

# A displayed pair keeps the original pairwise-distinctness WD guard.
forall a,b,x,y R, epsilon R+:
    a!=b
    x!=y
    abs(a-x)<=epsilon
    abs(b-y)<=epsilon
    $is_finite_set({a,b})
    $is_nonempty_set({a,b})
    {a,b} $subset R
    $is_finite_set({x,y})
    $is_nonempty_set({x,y})
    {x,y} $subset R
    =>:
        abs(finite_set_max({a,b})-finite_set_max({x,y}))<=epsilon
